build.details: From lean-causal: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true scaffold/CausalScaffold/SingularRowsLocal.lean` printed nothing and exited 0 (3.1 s). With ledger.py's strip_lean_comments the code has no `sorry`; the one textual « sorry » is the docstring prose « (no `sorry` in this file) » at l.41. The file has no private, axiom, native_decide, set_option, admit, opaque or extern. It does have two `attribute [local instance]` lines (l.356, l.415), which were already present and are unchanged. I ran #print axioms in a /tmp copy of the file (`lake env lean`, not lake build) on the three anchors J_int, cup_cap_sing and pas_plat_ii. Each gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. All 25 proof terms are byte-identical to the round-1 terms (below), so AUDIT-1's axiom result for the other 22 carries over. The /tmp directory (/tmp/srl-audit2) is deleted. I did not run lake build.

The regex finds lem:J_int, lem:cup_cap_sing, rem:tarentin_exemples and rem:lorentz_tarentin at offsets 2559, 2799, 3075 and 3236. Each listed every constant whose name contains SingularRowsLocal, with its kind, universe parameters, hash of the type and hash of the value. It also listed every declaration docstring and the module docstrings.
